vulnerable_code:
class Ability
  include CanCan::Ability

  def initialize(user)
    return unless user.present?

    # Misconfiguration: when user.tenant_id is nil (e.g. pending contractor),
    # this condition matches all CustomerLead records where tenant_id IS NULL
    can [:read, :update], CustomerLead, tenant_id: user.tenant_id
  end
end

class Crm::LeadsController < ApplicationController
  def show
    @lead = CustomerLead.find(params[:id])
    authorize! :read, @lead
    render json: @lead
  end
end
diagnosis: The Ability class binds permissions to user.tenant_id without asserting that user.tenant_id is present. For unassigned contractors or pending signups where tenant_id is nil, the rule grants read and update access to all unassigned enterprise leads.

corrected_code:
class Ability
  include CanCan::Ability

  def initialize(user)
    return unless user.present? && user.tenant_id.present?

    can [:read, :update], CustomerLead, tenant_id: user.tenant_id
  end
end

class Crm::LeadsController < ApplicationController
  def show
    @lead = CustomerLead.find(params[:id])
    authorize! :read, @lead
    render json: @lead
  end
end
